item.title: Romorgniz Recalls Six-Drawer Dressers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units
item.company: Zhangzhou Jinhao Sen Smart Home Co., Ltd., of China
item.brand: Zhangzhou Jinhao Sen Smart Home Co., Ltd., of China
item.summary: This recall involves Romorgniz six-drawer dressers. The wooden dressers were sold in white and black, measure about 27.6 inches wide, 15.6 inches long, 43.2 inches tall and weigh 73.3 pounds.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Romorgniz Six-Drawer Dressers.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled dressers immediately if they are not anchored to the wall, place them in an area that children cannot access and contact Romorgniz for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “RECALLED” on the top, front and sides of the dresser, remove all drawers and send photos of the marked and disassembled dresser to Romorgnizrecall@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
